title: LEMMA: Learning from Errors for MatheMatical Advancement in LLMs
authors_zh: Zhuoshi Pan、Yu Li、Honglin Lin、Qizhi Pei、Zinan Tang、Wei Wu、Chenlin Ming、H. Vicky Zhao、Conghui He、Lijun Wu
paper_type_zh: 过程与轨迹监督数据论文
best_for_zh: 需要构造错误—修正过程监督、训练数学推理自纠错能力的研究者。
one_line: LEMMA turns diverse model mistakes into error-to-correction training pairs, teaching mathematical LLMs to repair their own reasoning without an external critique model.
LEMMA 将多样化模型错误组织为错误到正确解的反思连接，使数学模型无需外部批评器也能在生成中自主纠错。
why: It preserves the first error and its repair path, making negative reasoning evidence directly usable for training rather than discarding it.
inclusion_reason: The official release provides reusable step-level supervision for training or evaluating reasoning reward models and verifiers.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Mathematical SFT usually distills only correct solutions, so models do not learn how their common first errors are repaired and continue propagating mistakes after divergence. Existing MCTS or high-temperature error collection is costly and can generate implausible errors the student would not make.

LEMMA first analyzes realistic error types and then constructs first-error prefixes, reflection links, and two kinds of corrected trajectories: fix-and-continue and fresh-and-restart.

数学 SFT 多只蒸馏正确解答，模型没有见过自己常犯的首错及其修复过程，推理中一旦偏离就会继续传播；已有 MCTS 或高温采错方法又成本高，且容易产生学生模型不会犯的荒谬错误。

LEMMA 先统计真实错误类型，再构造首错前缀、反思连接与“修复续推/重新求解”两类正确轨迹。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LEMMA organizes error data as a smooth correction trajectory containing the problem, faulty prefix, earliest error, reflection phrase, and correct continuation. The official dataset contains 88,904 records totaling about 87.3 MB. Errors come from the student model or are deliberately introduced by a teacher according to problem-specific error distributions; corrections use Fix & Continue or Fresh & Restart and support self-correction SFT rather than simple step classification.

Records also distinguish student-generated errors from teacher-injected errors, enabling separate realism audits.

LEMMA 将错误数据组织成“题目—错误前缀—首错—反思短语—正确续解”的平滑修正轨迹。官方数据含 88,904 条、约 87.3 MB，错误既来自学生模型自身，也由教师按问题级错误分布定向注入；正确部分采用 Fix & Continue 或 Fresh & Restart，可用于自我纠错 SFT，而非单纯步骤分类。

记录还区分学生模型原生错误与教师定向注入错误，便于分别审计真实性。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Analyze errors: Estimate distributions of problem misinterpretation, formula confusion, calculation errors, and other failures in mathematical solutions.
  2. Expand faulty trajectories: Retain student-generated errors and ask GPT-4o to deliberately create representative first errors from the same taxonomy.
  3. Generate corrections: Truncate at the first error and create either a fix-and-continue solution in context or a fresh correct restart.
  4. Connect smoothly: Generate reflection phrases explaining the error and transition, forming 88,904 SFT records.

1. 分析错误：在多类数学解答中统计误读、公式混淆和计算错误等分布。
  2. 扩充错轨迹：保留学生自身错误，并让 GPT-4o 按相同错误类型定向生成代表性首错。
  3. 生成修正：截断到首错，分别构造原上下文中继续修复和从头重解的正确轨迹。
  4. 平滑连接：生成解释错误与转向原因的 reflection phrase，拼成 88,904 条训练记录做 SFT。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper compares standard SFT, prior error-learning methods, and LEMMA under matched base models and training-data scales. On LLaMA3-8B, LEMMA improves average accuracy across mathematical benchmarks by up to 13.3% and retains gains on out-of-distribution sets; error analysis shows reductions in representative interpretation, formula, and calculation failures. The evidence supports structured correction data but does not fully isolate the long-term effect of each correction strategy.
论文在相同基础模型与训练数据规模下比较普通 SFT、已有错误学习方法和 LEMMA。LLaMA3-8B 使用 LEMMA 后在多个数学基准的平均准确率最高提升 13.3%，并在分布外集合保持增益；错误类型分析显示代表性误读、公式和计算错误均减少。结果支持结构化修正数据，但无法单独区分两种修正策略的长期作用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Existing error-learning methods often raise sampling temperature to collect failures or rely on MCTS and external critics for online repair. LEMMA first uses the student’s error distribution to decide which mistakes to synthesize and then connects each first error to two valid recovery paths in an SFT-ready sequence. The novelty is error-type-grounded data construction and smooth reflection connections rather than reflection prompting itself.

The resulting training data is therefore closer to the target model's actual failure distribution.

已有错误学习常提高采样温度收集失败解，或依赖 MCTS 与外部 critic 在线修正。LEMMA 的变化是先用学生错误分布定义“应合成什么错”，再把首错与两种正确恢复路径连接成可直接 SFT 的序列。新意在错误类型驱动的数据构造与平滑反思连接，而非反思提示本身。

因此训练数据更接近目标模型的真实失败分布。

title: Limitations
局限
html: First, earliest-error and error-type judgments rely largely on a teacher model, so classification bias determines later corrections and requires human auditing. Second, deliberately injected errors follow aggregate distributions but may not match the true error probability of a specific student. Third, the 88,904 records cover English mathematics; the model may learn reflection phrases as a fixed style rather than genuinely detecting errors.
第一，首错和错误类型主要由教师模型判断，分类偏差会决定后续修正内容，需抽样人工复核。第二，故意注入错误虽按总体分布采样，仍可能不符合具体学生模型的真实概率。第三，88,904 条记录覆盖数学英文任务；反思短语可能被模型学成固定格式而非真正检测错误。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: With an existing mathematical SFT corpus, the LEMMA pipeline can analyze target-model errors and produce training data containing earliest errors, reflections, and two recovery strategies. Evaluation should combine correction accuracy with preservation of valid prefixes. The official dataset can also train a self-correcting model directly. The pipeline is unsuitable when correct solutions or error types cannot be verified reliably.
已有数学 SFT 题库时，可用 LEMMA 流程先分析目标模型错误，再输出含首错、反思和两种恢复策略的训练集，用纠正准确率与原正确前缀保留率评估。官方数据也可直接训练自我纠错模型。若任务没有可确认的正确解，或错误类型难以可靠标注，不宜自动合成修正轨迹。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: LEMMA writes the first error and recovery process directly into SFT trajectories.
  2. Method handle: It analyzes errors, collects or injects first mistakes, generates two corrections, and connects them smoothly.
  3. Data handle: 88,904 records pair erroneous steps, reflections, and correct continuations.
  4. Evidence anchor: LLaMA3-8B gains up to 13.3% average accuracy across benchmarks.
  5. Reuse decision: It suits mathematical self-correction; verify first-error labels and synthetic-error realism first. Reproduction should separately compare preservation and correction rates for the two recovery strategies.

1. 定位：LEMMA 把首错与正确恢复过程直接写进 SFT 轨迹。
  2. 方法：统计错误、采集或注入首错、生成两类修正并平滑连接。
  3. 数据：88,904 条，配对错误步骤、反思与正确续解。
  4. 证据：LLaMA3-8B 多基准平均准确率最高提升 13.3%。
  5. 复用：适合数学自纠错；先核验首错标签与合成错误真实性。 复现时还应分别比较两种恢复策略的保留率与纠正率。
